question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The training program was designed (1)/ to make the employees capable to handle (2)/ complex queries efficiently (3)/ in customer support operations. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in the phrase "**capable to handle**."
 
• The correct usage is "**capable of handling**," as the phrase "capable" is followed by "of" and a gerund (verb ending in -ing).
 
• Thus, the phrase should read "**to make the employees capable of handling**."
